summary: Samantha Voix no longer drops a brain answer when the provider signals `interrupted` for the generation that the final INTERRUPT response retires: when the final readback goes out at once (no output looked open), an `interrupted` boundary arriving before any output of the answer, and its turnComplete, are attributed to the retired generation and dropped; the turn keeps its answer. A real barge-in (new owner turn or owner interruption) still interrupts it.
reason: S24 07/11 voice recette (bench app de467d38, Companion f81a7d78): « active le mode ne pas déranger », « mets un minuteur de deux minutes » and « oui, envoie » ended with an empty answer (playback=interrupted). The brain had answered (10.1 to 14.8 s, capability done); the app received `interrupted` 90 ms after the brain result, before any audio of the answer (app telemetry t44 current=true, no t30), and dropped the answer. In voiceTurnProtocol, asyncReadback resumes the receipt generation at once when outputEnded is true; an `interrupted` then sets t.interrupted on the answer itself. On 01/11 the same steps were green: the race depends on whether the provider still had the generation it opened for the SILENT acknowledgement.

capabilities.reason: Voice relay boundary handling only; no capability, route or registry change (registry owned by samantha-ui-playbooks).

architecture.reason: Same VoiceTurnProtocol owner and the same INTERRUPT readback; one per-turn flag bounds which provider boundary belongs to the retired generation.

limitations: The provider generation events were not captured on the S24 (no Companion trace of `interrupted` with its generation); the cause is inferred from app telemetry and the relay code, and is confirmed only by the next voice recette after deployment.
